Project developer at Talmenta (part-time, remote)

Hi all! Talmenta helps mathematicians move to AI-assisted research by bringing research managers and AI engineers into their groups. We're looking for one project developer to design these new research projects. After a professor has brought us their research area and open questions, you work out a Lean/AI project that gets them as close as is reasonable to new scientific results, decide which engineers and mathematicians the project needs, and approve the team before a research manager runs it. Deep, hands-on experience with Lean/AI workflows in mathematics is required.

The position is a part-time contractor role, fully remote and open worldwide, that you can combine with your current work. Compensation may include cash but is primarily equity. Full description. To apply, email jasper.kreeke@talmenta.org.

Best wishes
Jasper van de Kreeke
